title: Independent Living Residency Agreement — Article on Discharge for Nonpayment
content:
## Article 11 — Discharge for nonpayment

11.1 Larkspur may end a residency under the Independent Living Residency Agreement for nonpayment only after a monthly fee has remained past due for at least the past-due period of the apartment type before a discharge notice and a written discharge notice has been issued by the community's executive director.

11.2 The residency may be ended for nonpayment only once the discharge notice period of the apartment type has passed since the discharge notice was issued. The discharge period is counted in calendar days from the notice date recorded on the residency, and the residency may be ended on the notice date plus the discharge notice period in calendar days or later.

11.3 Payment in full of the past-due amount before the end of the discharge period cancels the discharge.

11.4 The desk never issues or cancels a discharge notice itself; a request to stop or delay a discharge is outside the desk's authority.

## The discharge clock at its boundary (hypothetical; 30-day discharge notice)

| Ending date for nonpayment | Allowed? |
|---|---|
| Notice date plus 29 calendar days | No |
| Notice date plus 30 calendar days | Yes |
| Later | Yes |

A discharge notice dated September 1 allows the residency to be ended for nonpayment on October 1 or later.

## Who acts

| Action | By whom |
|---|---|
| Issuing the written discharge notice | The community's executive director |
| Issuing or cancelling a discharge notice | Never the desk |
| Stopping or delaying a discharge on request | Outside the desk's authority |
